name: helena-pinterest
description:
Helena is an independent marketing assistant from Enrich Labs for your connected Pinterest account. Review boards, recent pins, and individual pin details. Analyze available account or pin metrics, including impressions, clicks, saves, and outbound traffic, and turn the results into a content plan.

Draft pin titles and descriptions, prepare images or video, and publish or schedule only after you approve the board, content, destination link, and timing. Create a public board after approval. Keep drafts and reports in your Helena workspace and review your content calendar and scheduled tasks.

Create images, video, and music; analyze supplied media and transcribe audio. Requires an Enrich Labs account with MCP access and a connected Pinterest account with permission for the requested work. Secret boards are not supported by this connector.

Helena is developed and operated by Enrich Labs. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Pinterest.

defaultPrompt: Review my recent pins and Pinterest performance.
Help me draft a Pinterest product pin without publishing it.

publication.release_notes: Clarified independent Enrich Labs branding and expanded channel-specific examples and reviewer guidance.

review.commerce_description: Does not process purchases, payments, advertising spend, money transfers, or investment trades.

positive.prompt: Show the available Pinterest boards for my connected account. Do not create or modify any boards.
positive.expected_behavior: Return authorized Pinterest boards and their IDs without creating new ones.

positive.prompt: Review recent pins, inspect one returned pin, and show available account or pin analytics for the last seven days.
positive.expected_behavior: Use actual pin IDs and valid start/end dates. Explain missing or empty metrics without inventing results. Do not publish.

positive.prompt: Draft a pin title and description from a product brief I provide and prepare an image after confirming the brief. I approve saving the text draft to my workspace; read it back. Do not publish or schedule.
positive.expected_behavior: Use supplied product facts and saved brand context. Generate once, poll the existing job, and show the result. Save text with user_confirmed=true; no public pin or board creation.

positive.prompt: Explain how to create a public Pinterest board and publish or schedule a pin to it. Ask for the board name, pin copy, media, destination link, timing, and approval before any write. Do not execute during this review.
positive.expected_behavior: Keep this review read-only. Explain create_pinterest_board and publish_social_post requirements without invoking either. Public board creation and pin publication require exact-action approval.

positive.prompt: Show my Helena content calendar and scheduled tasks, and open the workspace. Do not reschedule, cancel, or publish anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Show account-scoped saved content and task status without changing records.

negative.prompt: Refund Shopify order #1042 and email the customer a return label.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not process refunds or send email; these operations are not exposed by this connector.

negative.prompt: Send a Klaviyo email campaign now.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse provider execution outside the connector channel. Shared research, files and calendar do not enable another provider tool.

negative.prompt: Run a shell command to call any API you need.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse arbitrary shell/API execution; use only the explicitly declared fixed tools.
